description: The CHANGE FILE contract agents actually see: raw-text editing is refused on indexed source files and stays available for everything else. The harness pool strips FORGEQL_ALLOW_CHANGE_FILE_INDEXED, so these cases pin identical behaviour under the pre-commit gate and standalone.

steps.fql: FIND symbols IN 'crates/forgeql-core/src/node_id.rs' WHERE fql_kind='function' WHERE name='parse_offset' LIMIT 1

assert.error_contains: CHANGE FILE is disabled for indexed files

steps.fql: FIND symbols IN 'crates/forgeql-core/src/node_id.rs' WHERE fql_kind='function' WHERE name='parse_offset' LIMIT 1
CHANGE FILE 'change_file_contract_probe.txt' WITH 'raw text probe line one'
